definitions.explanation: A diary in which each day's page has a drawing above a few lines of writing; in Japan, the classic summer-vacation homework for young schoolchildren.

examples.japanese: {絵日記|えにっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絵日記|えにっき}だった。
examples.english: My summer vacation homework was a picture diary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絵日記|えにっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{返|かえ}す→読み返す：07954_yomikaesu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: Rereading my childhood picture diary brings back those days.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Elementary schools traditionally assign a {絵日記|えにっき} over the summer holidays: one page a day with a picture of something the child did and a few sentences about it. Writing a whole month of entries in the last days of August is a standing joke.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絵日記|えにっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける: to keep a picture diary
- ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絵日記|えにっき}: a summer-vacation picture diary
